subject: Request: Exec clearance for BrightLabs onboarding overlay & custom connector
messages:
From: Sam Howell <sam@brightlabs.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood proposal - premium onboarding + custom FHIR connector

Irene —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. BrightLabs is excited about the latency/throughput numbers you showed — this would be a core piece of our care coordination product. Before we move to procurement, I need to confirm one thing: our leadership wants the bundled onboarding package (concierge onboarding + premium support for year 1) included in the deal, and we also need a custom FHIR connector built to our spec as part of the engagement (we can share the integration spec).

High level ask: include concierge onboarding (normally $120,000) + premium support year 1 ($45,000) in the ARR/contract, and the custom connector dev work (estimated 160 hours) as a delivered, embedded service. In short, we want a single PO covering implementation + support; procurement will prefer not to manage separate SOWs.

I realize this is non-standard. Can your team route this for executive approval? BrightLabs is pushing to start implementation by mid-Oct if we can land terms this week.

Thanks,
Sam Howell
VP Product
BrightLabs

[Attachment: integration_spec.zip]

From: irene.choi@redwood.ai
To: Sam Howell <sam@brightlabs.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal - premium onboarding + custom FHIR connector

Sam —

Appreciate the clarity and the timeline. I can route this through Deal Desk + our sales leadership today. Two quick notes:
- We typically separate SOW for custom connector work from the standard concierge onboarding.
- Discounts and any waivers for dev-hours need exec signoff (Ben will be the approver).

I’m looping in Ben and Monica from CS to start sizing impact and draft a consolidated SOW. Ben — can you review the ask and advise on approval path? Monica — can your team estimate delivery cadence if we include the custom connector inside the onboarding package?

Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

From: irene.choi@redwood.ai

Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-21T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: FW: BrightLabs proposal — request for exec approval (pricing + inclusion of connector)

Ben / Deal Desk —

Forwarding BrightLabs request. Summary and recommended approach below:

Summary of customer ask:
- Consolidate concierge onboarding (list: $120,000) + premium support Y1 (list: $45,000) into the main contract; customer wants these "included" rather than proc separate line items.
- Build and deliver a custom FHIR connector to BrightLabs spec (estimated 160 dev hours). Customer requests the connector be included in the overall package (not a separate billable SOW).
- Timeline pressure: they want kickoff by mid-Oct (3 weeks).

Financials / options:
1) Standard price: Onboarding $120k + Support Y1 $45k + Connector billed separately (160h x $200/hr = $32k) = $197k total one-time + 45k support.
2) Proposed customer-facing bundle: we could offer a 25% bundle concession across onboarding + connector (not on support), bringing total TCV lower to accelerate close. Example math: (120k + 32k) = 152k; 25% concession -> 114k + Support 45k = 159k TCV.
3) Middle ground: Approve up to 20% concession on services line and a capped dev credit of $10k for connector work; customer pays remaining dev hours. That would be ~121.6k services +45k support = 166.6k.

Why approve (customer value / strategic rationale):
- BrightLabs is an early platform integration partner in the payer channel — strategic case for an expanded reference and potential co-marketing.
- High annual usage expectation; we see >3x uplift in token/mo after year 1 per pipeline conversation.
- Closing this quarter materially helps our Q3 ARR.

Risks / mitigations:
- Setting precedent for including engineering work in the onboarding bundle. Mitigation: cap total dev credit and document scope precisely in SOW.

Request: Exec approval for option (3) above — i.e., up to 20% concession on services and a one-time dev credit not to exceed $10,000. If you approve a larger concession (>=25% or full dev waiver), we need VP signoff from Revenue Ops.

Files attached: BrightLabs_SOW_v3.pdf (draft consolidated SOW), BrightLabs_cost_breakdown.xlsx (detail of numbers), integration_spec.zip (customer spec).

--
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Lead

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai, dealdesk@redwood.ai
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-21T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: BrightLabs proposal — request for exec approval (pricing + inclusion of connector)

Irene / Deal Desk —

Thanks for the clear write-up. I approve option (3): up to 20% concession on the services line and a one-time dev credit capped at $10k. Conditions:
1) Make the concession signalized in the contract as a one-time onboarding credit, not recurring.
2) CS must produce a milestone-based delivery plan and acceptance criteria that we attach to the SOW. Monica — please confirm the delivery timeline and that 160h estimate is realistic for inclusion within the Oct timeline.
3) Revenue Ops to review final contract language (I’m cc’ing Jonas for routing).

I will not approve a full dev-hours waiver beyond $10k without VP-level signoff. If the AE wants to push for more, escalate to me with a written ROI / reference case plan.

Ben Carter
VP, Sales Operations
ben.carter@redwood.ai
